note: Adapted from the species description in Chhotani (1997), the original being in English; alate not described in the original; the lower limit of labrum length and the upper limit of mandible length lost to OCR and not recorded, synonymy lists, figure numbers and distribution records not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellow to brown; thorax, legs and abdomen white to pale brown; mandibles yellow at the base, dark brown at the apex. Head sparsely hairy, body rather densely hairy. Body length 5.0–6.1 mm. Head capsule subrectangular, longer than wide, to mandibular base 1.70–2.00, width 1.03–1.18 mm; sides nearly straight, narrowing posteriorly to a slightly convex posterior margin. Fontanelle indistinct. Eyes and ocelli absent. Antennae hairy, 14-segmented; segment 2 smaller than segment 1 and longer than segment 3; segment 4 shortest. Clypeus divided into anteclypeus and postclypeus; anteclypeus hairless, white, narrow and band-like; postclypeus hairy, wider than long, clearly delimited from the frons. Labrum subtriangular (length about 0.20, width 0.26–0.30 mm), with a few long and short hairs. Mandibles stout and short, base broad, apex narrowed, tip sharp and slightly incurved; left mandible with a distinct tooth at about one third from the apex (tooth–apex distance 0.19–0.23 mm, tooth index 0.27), with a small notch at the base; right mandible also with a distinct tooth, situated slightly below one third from the apex (tooth–apex distance 0.21–0.30 mm, tooth index 0.35–0.37), with a smaller notch at the base. Postmentum long, rod-shaped (length 1.12–1.26, width 0.32–0.35, waist width 0.20–0.25 mm); widest at the apical third, waist rather long; anterior margin nearly straight, posterior margin concave. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, small (length 0.40–0.45, width 0.63–0.72 mm); anterior margin strongly convex. Mesonotum much narrower than the pronotum, metanotum slightly narrower. Legs hairy; mid legs shortest, fore and hind legs long; tibial apical spurs 3:2:2; tarsus 4-segmented. Abdomen elongate-oval, hairy; cerci 2-segmented, 0.04 mm; styli absent.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule yellow to yellowish brown; mandibles paler, teeth dark brown; thorax and legs yellow to brownish white; abdomen transparent, blackish from contents showing through. Head and body hairy. Body length 3.0–3.5 mm. Head subcircular, flat, slightly wider than long (to mandibular base 0.70–0.75, greatest width 0.82–0.87 mm). Fontanelle white, semitransparent, elongate, situated dorsally in the middle. Eyes and ocelli absent. Antennae hairy, 14-segmented, segment 4 shortest. Clypeus divided into anteclypeus and postclypeus; anteclypeus hairless, white, projecting in the middle; postclypeus hairy, wider than long (width 0.32–0.36, length 0.20–0.25 mm). Labrum wider than long (length 0.20–0.25, width 0.33–0.37 mm), anterior margin hairy. Mandibles of the Eurytermes type. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, small (length 0.21–0.25, width 0.45–0.50 mm).
